description: This file defines an abstract class 'ConnectionIssue' used to represent and track connection problems within log consistency protocols in Orleans. It includes properties for timestamps, failure counts, and retry delays, and an abstract method for computing retry delays based on previous attempts.

classes.name: ConnectionIssue
classes.description: An abstract class representing connection issues encountered in log consistency protocols, including properties for timestamps, failure counts, retry delays, and an abstract method for calculating retry delays.

methods.name: ComputeRetryDelay
methods.description: Abstract method to compute the retry delay based on previous delay, to be implemented by subclasses.
